title: Bracket (16→1 tournament)
description: Longform-native tournament. 16 competitors, 4 rounds (R16/QF/SF/F). Each round decides on one stat from each competitor's stats bag. R16 authors explicit pairs; later rounds auto-pair the previous round's winners positionally. Per-matchup winnerRef overrides the numeric winner so you can hand-author upsets (the funniest winner ≠ the higher number). Macro-loop = 'who wins the whole thing'; micro-loop = each reveal.

competitors.label: Competitors (16). Stable id is referenced by matchups + advancement.

stats.label: Stat bag — any keys a round can decide on (e.g. power, speed, brain)

rounds.label: Rounds in order (R16 first, Final last).

stat.label: Which stat key decides this round

unit.label: Unit shown on the value (PWR, MPH, …)

matchups.label: Explicit pairs (R16 only). Omit for auto rounds.

winnerRefs.label: OPTIONAL upset overrides for an AUTO round, positional by matchup (null = let the number decide)

pacing.label: OPTIONAL timeline tuning (seconds). Defaults give a ~70s v1 spine.

match.label: Per-match seconds by round index, escalating (default [2.0, 3.4, 4.8, 7.5])
